subject: Order Form — commencement fee, invoicing & tax path
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order Form — commencement fee, invoicing & tax path

Hi Elena,

Thanks for reviewing the order form draft. Attached is the current OrderForm_v2.pdf — key commercial items I want to confirm before we send this to DocuSign: 

- Commencement fee: proposed as a single upfront invoice for 50k (covers onboarding & reserved capacity). Would Novamed prefer splitting that into multiple invoices (e.g., 50/50 at signature / 30 days)?
- Net terms: our standard is Net45. If Novamed requires Net60 for AP cadence, we can discuss but need to align on PO timing and late fee terms.
- Invoicing entity & tax: please confirm the exact billing entity (Novamed entity name + tax id) and the email for AP. Also let us know if Novamed will withhold taxes (and if so, what documentation you need from us — W-9 or equivalent).
- Minimum commit cadence: we propose quarterly drawdowns against the committed token balance. Do you need that mapped to a PO or internal project code?

If you can confirm the above items today, we can incorporate redlines and circulate an updated order form + DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: OrderForm_v2.pdf

From: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: ap@novamed.com, legal@novamed.com
Date: 2027-09-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — commencement fee, invoicing & tax path

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the draft. A few notes from procurement & finance: 

1) Commencement fee: we would prefer the fee split into two invoices (50% at signature, 50% 30 days after). This helps our cashflow gating.
2) Net terms: our standard supplier terms are Net60. We can provide an exception for Net45 only with senior approval; otherwise please expect Net60.
3) Invoicing entity: please invoice Novamed Systems, Inc. (EIN available on request). Invoices should be sent to ap@novamed.com; please cc legal@novamed.com so we have visibility.
4) Tax/withholding: we do sometimes withhold taxes for foreign vendors — please include your W-9 or US tax residency evidence. If Redwood is a foreign entity, we will need the appropriate tax forms (W-8BEN-E).
5) PO: we will raise a PO once final commercial terms are agreed; please include a PO number field on the invoice and note our internal requirement to receive a PO within 10 business days of signature.

Please provide a redline of the order form (we will circulate internally). Looking forward to the updated version and the DocuSign link.

Best,
Elena Morales
Dir. Procurement, Novamed Systems

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Order Form — commencement fee, invoicing & tax path

Internal — quick summary from Novamed. They want: 50/50 commencement fee split, Net60, invoices to ap@novamed.com (cc legal). They will raise PO post-signature but expect PO within ~10 business days.

Suggested internal posture:
- Split commencement fee as requested (50/50) to keep the deal moving.
- We prefer Net45; but accepting Net60 is OK if we get commitment on PO timing + modest late fee to reduce risk.
- Confirm invoicing entity = Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) unless finance/legal advise otherwise.
- Legal: can you draft redlines to add a discrete clause around withholding/tax responsibility and an invoice dispute timeline (30 days)?

Attaching my markups: redlines_orderform_kp_v1.docx

Ben
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — commencement fee, invoicing & tax path

Ben / Kim — see legal input below (high level). I attached a tracked PDF with redlines (legal_redline_orderform_track.pdf). Main points we should include in the Order Form / MSA appendix: 

1) Invoicing entity & currency: specify Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: XX-XXXXXXX) as the invoicing entity for US deals. If Novamed requires alternate entity, we will need a signed entity addendum and tax evidence. Invoices will be issued in USD.
2) Taxes & withholding: add clear clause that "Customer is responsible for all taxes, duties and withholdings assessed on payments to Redwood, except taxes based on Redwood's net income." If customer withholds, they must provide official withholding documentation and any tax certificates within 30 days.
3) Payment terms & PO: we can accept Net60 to accommodate Novamed, but add: (a) PO required within 10 business days of signature; (b) invoice disputes must be raised within 30 days or invoice deemed accepted; (c) late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
4) Commencement fee split: OK to split 50/50 (invoice 1 at signature; invoice 2 at 30 days). For accounting, include line items that reference the committed token schedule.
5) Audit & evidence: include clause that customer may request tax evidence (W-9 / W-8BEN-E) and Redwood will provide within 5 business days.

These are standard protective items. If Sales wants to push for Net45 we can try, but given timeline and deal velocity accept Net60 with above protections.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Commercial Agreements
Redwood Inference
attachments: legal_redline_orderform_track.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — commencement fee, invoicing & tax path

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clarity on AP requirements. Per internal alignment with Legal and Sales, here is what we can confirm and will reflect in the updated order form: 

- Commencement fee: we will split 50% at signature and 50% 30 days after signature.
- Net terms: we will accept Net60 as Novamed requests. To manage risk, please note the following: we ask that Novamed provide the PO number within 10 business days of signature; invoices not disputed within 30 days will be considered accepted; late balances will accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
- Invoicing & entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. will issue invoices in USD to ap@novamed.com (please confirm the legal entity name and EIN to appear on the invoice — you mentioned "Novamed Systems, Inc."). We will attach a W-9 with the final DocuSign package.
- Taxes/withholding: as noted by Legal, the Customer remains responsible for taxes/withholdings on payments. If withholding occurs, please provide official documentation and the certificate within 30 days so we can process crediting.

Next steps: we will circulate an updated order form with legal redlines attached (OrderForm_redline_for_docusign.pdf) and send a DocuSign link. Please confirm you are okay with the 50/50 commencement invoice split and Net60 with the PO/late fee conditions, and confirm the exact invoice party name and EIN. Once confirmed we will route the DocuSign envelope.

DocuSign link (will be live once redlines accepted): https://www.docusign.com/link/XX-ABCD-20270907

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: OrderForm_redline_for_docusign.pdf
